_meta.description: Externalized configuration for the Cloud-Operations Discovery Pack: pack version, NOC terminology set, detector thresholds, and scorer calibration. Loaded from this file so a config change alters pack behaviour with no code deploy (MSP-B6 T1 AC2). Detector and scorer LOGIC is not here (T2/T3/T4) — only the values those tasks read.
_meta.note: Editing a value below changes behaviour on the next run; no restart or code change required.

terminology._note: The NOC vocabulary this pack speaks in findings, roadmap, and executive report — the same externalized mechanism the lending pack uses to drive borrower/covenant language. glossary defines each canonical NOC term (MSP-B6 T1 AC3); language_map re-labels generic AgentIQ vocabulary into NOC language for terminology-aware rendering (later tasks).

glossary.alerts: Automated notifications raised by monitoring or event sources when a metric or condition crosses a defined boundary.
glossary.incidents: Tracked ITSM records representing a service disruption or degradation worked to resolution.
glossary.runbooks: Documented, repeatable operational procedures for resolving a known incident or performing a known task.
glossary.mttr: Mean time to resolve — the median elapsed time from incident open to close, the core effort measure for operations findings.
glossary.toil: Manual, repetitive operational work that scales with service growth and produces no lasting value — the primary automation-candidate signal.
glossary.escalation: Reassignment of an incident to another group or queue, or elevation in priority, when the current owner cannot resolve it.

thresholds._note: Detector firing boundaries. Read by the detectors built in MSP-B6 T2/T3; no detector logic lives here.

calibration._note: Ops impact scorer calibration. Read by the scorer built in MSP-B6 T4; no scorer logic lives here. impact_weights are relative ranking weights across the four dimensions in Section 2 of the scope; automation_shape/recurrence_stability carry the per-dimension thresholds the scorer derives those two 0..1 dimension scores from (T4 AC2 — a value change alters ranked order with no code deploy); confidence describes the honest-confidence caps enforced at the pack boundary (T6).

automation_shape._note: Automation-shape dimension (0..1): a trivially-resolved finding (short MTTR, one close code) scores high and outranks a judgment-heavy one (T4 AC3). Derived from median MTTR against these bounds unless the finding carries an explicit automation_shape value.

recurrence_stability._note: Recurrence-stability dimension (0..1): a steady cadence scores higher than a bursty one. Used when a finding carries a recurrence_shape ('steady'/'burst') or an interarrival coefficient-of-variation; otherwise the default applies.
